After passing Higher Secondary from Tagore School, Karnal in 1976, she did her Bachelor's in Aeronautical Engineering from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh in 1982. Her last mission was Columbia flight STS-107. It took off on 16 January 2003 for science and research. The crew performed eighty experiments. Sadly, 16 minutes before landing the spacecraft developed a snag, and Columbia perished with her crew on 1 February 2003.
